title: SR Python Engineer + Java
description:
Ascendion is a full-service digital engineering solutions company. We make and manage software platforms and products that power growth and deliver captivating experiences to consumers and employees. Our engineering, cloud, data, experience design, and talent solution capabilities accelerate transformation and impact for enterprise clients.


We are looking for a strong SR Python Engineer with Java and AI Integration exp, with the next qualifications:


  • Python (advanced): 80% of the work involves backend/API development.
  • NoSQL databases: experience with MongoDB or similar is required.
  • Search engine: experience with Elasticsearch (or OpenSearch / Solr) is highly valued.
  • AWS Cloud : DynamoDB and other AWS services, plus experience with containers (Docker, ECS, or EKS).
  • Java: solid understanding of Core Java (version 11 preferred).
  • Version control & CI/CD: GitHub and Jenkins (basic working knowledge is sufficient).
  • Familiarity with Python-based AI integrations or real-time AI products.


Experience: 6–8 years

  • English Level: Advanced (C1)


About the Role

We’re looking for a Python Backend Engineer who’s passionate about building scalable, high-performance systems in the cloud.

This is a hands-on development role, you’ll be designing APIs, adding new product features, and helping integrate AI functionalities into production systems.


What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain backend services and APIs using Python (core focus).
  • Develop new features and enhance existing ones across a large-scale cloud platform.
  • Work on AI-driven functionality, connecting data and services through Python integrations.
  • Contribute to a robust cloud infrastructure on AWS, using containers and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth deployment and high reliability.


Want to change the world? Let us know.

  • Tell us about your experiences, education, and ambitions. Bring your knowledge, unique viewpoint, and creativity to the table. Let’s talk!

title: Software Engineer Intern
description:
Company Description

LAB Tech Analytics is a dynamic and forward-thinking small company dedicated to revolutionizing data-driven solutions. We empower businesses to unlock the true potential of their data assets with our comprehensive suite of services. From our top-notch data recruitment and training hub to our cutting-edge data products and services, we provide end-to-end solutions for every stage of the data lifecycle. Our expert team combines technical excellence with deep industry knowledge to deliver actionable insights, advanced analytics, robust data infrastructure, and strategic guidance.


Role Description

This is a contract remote role for a Software Engineer Intern. The Software Engineer Intern will be responsible for developing, testing, and maintaining software applications, assisting in the design and implementation of new features, and collaborating with the engineering team to improve existing systems. The intern will also participate in code reviews, write clear and efficient code, and troubleshoot issues as they arise.


Qualifications

  • Experience in programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, C++)
  • Understanding of software development methodologies and tools
  • Interest in learning and both front-end and back-end development
  • Familiarity with databases and data structures
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Ability to work independently and remotely
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Brazilian Portuguese
  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
  • Experience with data analytics and machine learning is a plus

title: Customer Success Specialist
description:
Joom Pulse is a data platform that provides analytics and recommendations for marketplace sellers. Its features allow you to review the most profitable products, know the estimated profit of buying directly from the supplier, discover the categories with the greatest growth potential, and explore profitable ways to expand your business. Joom Pulse helps make e-commerce data easy to understand and efficient for all sellers.


Joom Pulse is one of the key businesses of Joom, an international group of e-commerce companies that was founded in 2016 in Latvia. Joom also includes the following businesses: Joom Marketplace, a platform for shopping from all over the world; Onfy, a pharmaceutical marketplace in Germany, and JoomPro, a platform for cross-border wholesale trade. Joom’s offices are located in Latvia, China, Hong Kong, the USA, Germany, Brazil, and Portugal. Joom Group has its HQ in Lisbon, Portugal.


We are looking for a proactive, customer-focused Customer Success Specialist to foster strong client relationships, enhance user satisfaction, and support seamless product adoption and retention.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain strong client relationships, ensuring alignment with customer needs
  • Provide fast & full answers to clients’ questions and support for their problems
  • Keep customers informed on new features and best practices to enhance usage
  • Monitor customer engagement and satisfaction to identify upsell and renewal opportunities
  • Lead renewal processes and identify growth opportunities within customer accounts
  • Ensure high retention rate by providing excellent customer success service & support


Requirements

  • 1+ years of experience in customer success management
  • Fluency in Portuguese
  • Advanced communication skills with ability to handle difficult client conversations, build client trust and understand client perspectives
  • Ability to collect, structure, and filter clients’ feedback, and transfer this to the stakeholders as marketing manager, product manager, and other internal teams
  • Hands-on experience with customer retention and nurturing relationships with small and medium businesses
  • Strong analytical skills and data-driven approach
  • Practical use experience of AI tools and quick software learning ability
  • Experience working based on KPIs (SLA, CSAT, Retention, Churn, Refunds) and results-oriented execution


Preferred

  • Good English proficiency and
  • Experience working in a similar Brazilian e-commerce and/or analytical tools’ company


We offer

  • Compensation package: base salary and bonuses
  • PJ employment with a possibility to move to CLT employment later
  • 100% paid sick leave
  • Collaboration with colleagues across Portugal, Brazil, Latvia and China, with opportunities for promotions


Before applying for the above position, please review our Candidate Privacy Notice here: By responding to the vacancy, you acknowledge that you have read our Privacy notice.*

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
About us:


Smarter Contact is the #1 messaging platform for real estate professionals in the U.S. Our SaaS product powers millions of conversations to close more deals through smart SMS, voice, and automation.


We’re a fast-growing SaaS company, leading the market and scaling fast — and we’re looking for a seasoned Full Stack engineer to join our high-performance team and build impactful features across our product suite.


If you're tired of slow, corporate environments and want to move fast, own decisions, and ship work that matters — this is your moment.


What You’ll Own:

  • Design and build high-impact features across our Node, Typescript, and ReactJS stack
  • Architect scalable systems and lead technical decision-making
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to connect product ideas to execution
  • Take ownership of user experience, performance, and system design
  • Dive into complex user journeys and translate them into clean, scalable code
  • Build for scale using GCP, PostgreSQL, and microservice-based architecture
  • Proactively identify technical gaps, raise flags, and propose improvements
  • Help maintain a high-quality codebase while shipping fast

title: Venture Analyst
description:
About Flow Capital

Flow Capital Corp. is a publicly listed provider of flexible growth and alternative capital solutions dedicated to supporting market-leading, high-growth companies. Since 2018, we’ve helped businesses in the US, UK, and Canada access financing that drives growth while minimizing dilution and retaining founder control. Our focus is on revenue-generating, VC-backed, and founder-owned companies seeking growth capital. Learn more at 



Overview


We’re looking for an entry-level analyst to join our venture team at Flow Capital. This role sits between our Marketing and Originations teams, starting with a focus on marketing. You’ll support a wide range of activities, including identifying and researching potential investment opportunities and supporting business development, while also contributing to marketing campaigns, content creation, and brand initiatives.

This is an excellent entry point for someone interested in gaining exposure to the venture ecosystem.


  • Location: Remote. Candidates must be available to work North American Eastern Time (GMT-4).
  • Fluent English (written and spoken). Proof of fluency will be required.
  • Please submit your resume in English only.



Responsibilities

  • Conduct research to identify potential investment and partner opportunities.
  • Conduct ad-hoc analysis (e.g., market sizing, competitive analysis, web analytics data).
  • Support lead generation and outbound email campaign setup, monitoring, and reporting.
  • Collaborate with marketing to create content, marketing materials and assist with digital initiatives as needed.
  • Track and analyze performance, providing insights to improve engagement and conversion rates.
  • Participate in events, webinars, and other initiatives to build Flow Capital’s brand.
  • Manage and update CRM records.



Qualifications

  • Business or a related field degree from a strong academic program.
  • A passion for early stage investing and a desire to be in the Venture Ecosystem.
  • Entry-level role. 0–2 years of experience in venture, business development, or finance preferred, but not required
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Strong spreadsheet skills.
  • Curious, proactive, eager to learn and take on new challenges. 
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines with minimal supervision.
  • Proactive, versatile, and comfortable handling a variety of tasks across marketing functions
  • Familiarity with tools including AI tools, Webflow, HubSpot, Canva, outreach tools (e.g., Reply.io), PitchBook, SEMrush, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and Google Analytics.



Why Join Flow Capital?  

  • Be part of a leading Canadian venture debt firm working with high-growth companies.
  • Gain exposure to venture capital, finance, and growth-stage tech ecosystems.
  • Join a small, collaborative team where your work has a direct impact.



Only applicants selected for an interview will be contacted. Thank you for your interest.

title: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior
description:
Código da oportunidade: 53504


Há mais de 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei , venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- Detalhes das atividades:

Desenvolver pipelines de ingestão e transformação de dados com AWS Glue, Lambda e EMR. Otimizar armazenamento e consultas utilizando Amazon S3, Redshift, RDS e DynamoDB. Automatizar processos com Step Functions e scripts Python. Monitorar workloads com CloudWatch e aplicar boas práticas de segurança e compliance. Participar de decisões técnicas junto aos times de engenharia, arquitetura e produto. Contribuir com a evolução da arquitetura em AWS e disseminar boas práticas de engenharia de dados.

Atuação 100% home Office


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Sales representative
description:
ABOUT US


Property Leads is a premium Pay-Per-Lead company that generates high-quality, inbound, motivated seller leads for real estate investors. We are a team of ambitious, results-driven individuals with bold goals for both our company and our personal growth. While many companies describe themselves as a family, we see ourselves as a high-performance sports team, focused, competitive, and committed to winning.

We're looking for someone who is motivated, friendly, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is ready to take on challenges head-on.

THE ROLE


We’re hiring a dynamic and driven Sales & Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team. This role is responsible for selling motivated seller leads to both inbound and outbound prospects, managing their pipeline, and serving as a key point of contact in our customer journey.

This is more than just a sales role, as you’ll be the first impression of Property Leads. Professionalism, strong communication skills, great English, and the ability to build rapport quickly are essential. You should be passionate about helping people succeed and eager to grow within a fast-moving organization.

This role is best suited for individuals with at least one year of experience in commission-based sales.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Conduct onboarding calls, schedule new appointments, and nurture leads in the pipeline

  • Manage and optimize our CRM to enhance lead tracking, segmentation, and conversion

  • Analyze lead data and provide actionable insights to improve sales and outreach

  • Ensure timely follow-up and accurate documentation of all client interactions

  • Work closely with the Sales Manager to drive performance and refine processes

    • QUALIFICATIONS

    • 1+ years of commission sales experience

    • Strong

    • 1+ years of CRM management experience, ideally in real estate or lead generation

    • Proficiency in CRM platforms (e.g., GoHighLevel) and Airtable

    • Strong problem-solving skills

    • This role requires strong proficiency in both written and verbal English. You should be comfortable drafting emails, participating in meetings, and handling client interactions.

    • Self-motivated and collaborative with a strong sense of accountability

    • Self-aware and heavy emphasis on constant self-improvement.

    • WHAT WE OFFER

    • Competitive base pay with performance-based bonuses

    • Remote-friendly work environment

    • Clear paths for career advancement and professional development

    • Supportive, high-performing team culture

title: Gerente de Loja | Castanheira, Belém | Natura
description:
A Natura tem por essência a paixão pela cosmética e pelas relações. E é esse cuidado, o nosso jeito de ser e fazer que Só Podia ser a Natura. Fazemos com que os mais de 200 milhões de consumidores que entram nas nossas lojas, se sintam especiais e desfrutem da nossa consultoria de beleza.


Se você quer ser Gerente de Loja Natura e fazer parte do dia a dia, da autoestima e dos momentos das pessoas e ainda desenvolver talentos na melhor empresa de beleza PARA o mundo, essa é a sua chance! Confira nossas vagas e venha, do seu jeito, prosperar com a gente!



Endereço: BR-316, Km 01 - Castanheira, Belém - PA,



O que estamos buscando?

Estamos em busca de um profissional para liderar nossa equipe e operações de loja com cuidado e atenção. Seu papel será fundamental para fidelizar nossos clientes e atrair novos consumidores para a nossa marca. Conectando-se com nossos valores, você garantirá uma experiência diferenciada tanto para os clientes quanto para sua equipe.

Procuramos alguém com vívida experiência em gestão de pessoas e resultados, que valorize o desenvolvimento profissional e reconheça o poder da diversidade para gerar valor.



O que você vai fazer por aqui?

  • Responsável pelo processo de recrutamento e seleção dos nossos talentos;
  • Responsável pelos processos de gestão de pessoas do seu time de vendedores(as) (controle de ponto, escala de trabalho e etc.);
  • Desenvolver a equipe através de reuniões e treinamentos, mantendo-a motivada e alinhada com a empresa;
  • Aplicar avaliação de desempenho da equipe;
  • Realizar a gestão de indicadores e melhoria de performance dos resultados;
  • Responsável pelo fluxo de caixa da loja;
  • Implementar e manter o Visual Merchandising de acordo com as diretrizes do Marketing da Natura;
  • Responsável pela receita da loja e gestão do inventário;
  • Realizar reuniões mensais de resultado;
  • Conhecer e disseminar a Visão e a Missão da Empresa;
  • Responsável por cumprir com as políticas, regras e normas de Segurança do Trabalho e Saúde ocupacional de seu local ou processo de trabalho;
  • Obedecer todos os regulamentos e procedimentos de trabalho da empresa;
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria.



Quais conhecimentos e vivências você vai precisar para compartilhar com a nossa rede?

  • Ensino superior cursando ou concluído;
  • Experiência com gestão de indicadores e melhoria contínua;
  • Excel ou ferramentas semelhantes;
  • Vivência com gestão de pessoas e experiência como líder de equipe;
  • Desejável conhecimento em atendimento consultivo;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar domingos alternados (1x1);
  • Experiência em vendas e com entrega de resultados;
  • Conhecimento de marketing e VM;
  • Experiência com facilitação de conteúdos;
  • Experiência em operação de loja.



Nossos Benefícios

  • Vale Refeição
  • Vale Transporte
  • Assistência médica + seguro de vida

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Ascendion is a full-service digital engineering solutions company. We make and manage software platforms and products that power growth and deliver captivating experiences to consumers and employees. Our engineering, cloud, data, experience design, and talent solution capabilities accelerate transformation and impact for enterprise clients. Headquartered in New Jersey, our workforce of 6,000+ Ascenders delivers solutions from around the globe. Ascendion is built differently to engineer the next.

Ascendion | Engineering to elevate life

We have a culture built on opportunity, inclusion, and a spirit of partnership. Come, change the world with us:

  • Build the coolest tech for world’s leading brands
  • Solve complex problems – and learn new skills
  • Experience the power of transforming digital engineering for Fortune 500 clients
  • Master your craft with leading training programs and hands-on experience

Experience a community of change makers!

Join a culture of high-performing innovators with endless ideas and a passion for tech. Our culture is the fabric of our company, and it is what makes us unique and diverse. The way we share ideas, learning, experiences, successes, and joy allows everyone to be their best at Ascendion.

About the Role:


  • Role: Full Stack Engineer
  • Location: Brazil (Remote)
  • Employment Type: Contract
  • Skill : Python and Angular with AWS


What You’ll Do

  • Develop and maintain backend services in Python and frontend features in Angular .
  • Design and implement RESTful APIs , integrate with NoSQL databases , and ensure efficient data flow.
  • Deploy, test, and monitor features on AWS cloud infrastructure.
  • Collaborate within a 6-person Agile team to deliver high-quality, production-ready code.
  • Participate in code reviews, CI/CD workflows, and cloud container deployments.


Tech Stack & Requirements

  • Backend
  • Python (advanced) – core focus for API and service development.
  • Exposure to AI integrations in Python systems.
  • AWS Cloud – DynamoDB and containerized environments (Docker, ECS, EKS).
  • NoSQL Databases – MongoDB or equivalent.
  • Search – Elasticsearch / OpenSearch / Solr.
  • Java 11 (basic knowledge) – secondary backend language.
  • Frontend
  • Angular (TypeScript, HTML, CSS) – ability to build interactive web UIs.
  • Tools
  • GitHub and Jenkins for version control and CI/CD.

title: Analista de Processos Pl.
description:
Você quer fazer parte de uma empresa com propósito? Fazer acontecer inspirando o melhor das pessoas está no DNA da nossa gente. #VemSerNumen


Prezamos por pessoas que:

  • Buscam comprometimento e excelência em suas entregas;
  • Criam e disseminam um ambiente colaborativo, com espírito de equipe, onde a amizade é valorizada;
  • Queiram atuar com profissionais de confiança;
  • E acreditam que o respeito e a humildade são essenciais para o seu dia a dia aqui na Numen.


Se você se identifica com tudo isso e quer ser Numen, não perca a oportunidade de participar desse processo seletivo!


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES


  • Experiência no setor de Seguros e/ou Resseguros, com entendimento das principais operações e fluxos de negócio.
  • Vivência na coleta e análise de requisitos, traduzindo necessidades do negócio em visões claras de produto e especificações funcionais.
  • Conhecimento dos processos e estrutura organizacional de empresas do setor, compreendendo suas interdependências e impactos operacionais.
  • Conhecimento em BPMN (Business Process Model and Notation) e capacidade de modelar processos de negócio utilizando essa notação – diferencial desejável.
  • Experiência em mapeamento e análise de processos, incluindo documentação detalhada, identificação de gargalos e riscos.
  • Foco em resultados e melhoria contínua, com mentalidade orientada à entrega de valor e evolução dos processos.
  • Necessário inglês fluente para atuação em times multiculturais.
  • Necessário conhecimento em metodologias ágeis.


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES


  • Atuar como parceiro(a) dos responsáveis pelos processos, produtos e usuários de negócio, compreendendo detalhadamente os requisitos e necessidades originais.
  • Mapear e desenhar processos As Is, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e propondo processos To Be.
  • Colaborar com a equipe de TI na avaliação do ambiente tecnológico, considerando suas capacidades e limitações.
  • Traduzir requisitos de negócio em histórias de usuário claras e objetivas.
  • Definir critérios de aceitação para validação das histórias de usuário.
  • Elaborar, em conjunto com os responsáveis pelos processos e usuários de negócio, os casos e cenários de teste positivos e negativos.
  • Participar do planejamento de projetos, definição de cronogramas, reuniões diárias e demais rituais necessários.
  • Apoiar usuários de negócio e equipe de TI na validação das soluções desenvolvidas.
  • Preparar e apresentar relatórios e materiais de acompanhamento de projetos e atividades.
  • Comunicar de forma proativa as evoluções, bloqueios e riscos identificados ao longo do projeto.


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS


  • Modalidade: Atuação 100% remota.
  • Contratação: Efetiva por tempo indeterminado.


BENEFÍCIOS


  • Vale Transporte (para vagas híbridas e presenciais)
  • Vale Refeição
  • Vale Alimentação
  • Swile Shop
  • TotalPass
  • Vittude
  • Assistência Médica Sulamérica
  • Assistência Odonto Sulamérica
  • Auxílio-Creche
  • Benefício para filhos PCD
  • Previdência Privada
  • Numen School

title: M365 Consultant
description:
English-speaking Microsoft 365 Consultant


$3,500 – $5,000 USD/month

Fully Remote

Full-time, long-term contract

Excellent English skills required for this position


About the Company

Join a US-based Cloud Expert MSP delivering enterprise-grade Microsoft 365, Azure, and multi-cloud solutions to global clients.

Their teams help organizations secure, optimize, and modernize their Microsoft ecosystems — improving collaboration, compliance, and operational efficiency across M365, Azure, and hybrid environments.


You’ll be part of a specialist Microsoft 365 Center of Excellence, working alongside senior engineers and consultants who design, implement, and manage advanced enterprise environments.

This is a long-term remote opportunity to grow your career in a world-class Microsoft ecosystem — with exposure to architecture, automation, governance, and continuous service improvement.


The Role

As a Microsoft 365 Consultant, you’ll take end-to-end ownership of operational, architectural, administrative, and consultative responsibilities across enterprise M365 environments.

This is a hands-on engineering and advisory position — blending technical depth with strategic consulting. You’ll work directly with enterprise clients to keep their Microsoft 365 ecosystems secure, compliant, cost-efficient, and aligned with evolving business needs.

You’ll work on:


  • Leading monthly environment reviews and recommending strategic improvements
  • (Secure Score, license optimization, usage insights, product roadmap updates)
  • Designing and maintaining Microsoft 365 architectures aligned with Microsoft best practices
  • Configuring and deploying M365 services (Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, Intune, etc.)
  • Monitoring service health, telemetry, and usage to proactively resolve issues
  • Performing incident, request, and change management activities
  • Contributing to documentation including configuration designs and operational procedures
  • Collaborating in change control, adoption, and stabilization meetings
  • Coordinating with Microsoft Support when escalations are required


This is not a traditional support role — you’ll engage directly with customers, provide insights on modernization, and shape the future of their Microsoft 365 environments.


What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years’ experience in Microsoft 365 administration, engineering, or consulting
  • Hands-on expertise in Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, Intune, Entra ID (Azure AD)
  • Strong understanding of governance, compliance, and security best practices in M365
  • Experience managing and optimizing Microsoft licensing, consumption, and usage reporting
  • Familiarity with PowerShell scripting, automation, and M365 monitoring tools
  • Ability to conduct environmental health checks and present improvement recommendations
  • Experience working in a customer-facing or MSP environment
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills


Who You Are

  • A trusted Microsoft 365 specialist who loves solving complex technical challenges
  • A consultative communicator comfortable advising enterprise clients directly
  • A self-starter who can manage multiple customer environments independently
  • A continuous learner, always keeping up with new Microsoft releases and best practices
  • A team player who thrives in a high-performing, collaborative culture


Why You’ll Love It Here

  • Work fully remote from anywhere
  • Competitive pay: $4,000 – $5,500 USD/month
  • Long-term engagement with enterprise US clients
  • Focus on certification and career growth (Microsoft exams covered every 6 months)
  • Exposure to advanced Microsoft environments and governance frameworks
  • Collaborative, senior-level culture — no micromanagement, no bureaucracy

The Role

As a Microsoft 365 Consultant, you’ll take end-to-end ownership of operational, architectural, administrative, and consultative responsibilities across enterprise M365 environments.

This is a hands-on engineering and advisory position — blending technical depth with strategic consulting. You’ll work directly with enterprise clients to keep their Microsoft 365 ecosystems secure, compliant, cost-efficient, and aligned with evolving business needs.

You’ll work on:


  • Leading monthly environment reviews and recommending strategic improvements
  • (Secure Score, license optimization, usage insights, product roadmap updates)
  • Designing and maintaining Microsoft 365 architectures aligned with Microsoft best practices
  • Configuring and deploying M365 services (Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, Intune, etc.)

  • Performing incident, request, and change management activities
  • Contributing to documentation including configuration designs and operational procedures
  • Collaborating in change control, adoption, and stabilization meetings
  • Coordinating with Microsoft Support when escalations are required


This is not a traditional support role — you’ll engage directly with customers, provide insights on modernization, and shape the future of their Microsoft 365 environments.

title: "FINOPS/SAP Licensing Analyst #983107 "

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Gerenciar e otimizar custos de nuvem, garantindo eficiência financeira e alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio.
  • Assegurar conformidade com acordos de licenciamento SAP, otimizando o uso de licenças e evitando custos desnecessários.
  • Implementar e gerenciar dashboards e processos que forneçam visibilidade em tempo real sobre a eficiência dos recursos de nuvem e custos associados.
  • Colaborar com equipes de TI e áreas de negócio para promover uma cultura de colaboração interfuncional e responsabilidade financeira.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência em gestão de custos de nuvem e otimização de recursos (FinOps).

  • Adaptabilidade a prazos apertados e mudanças de prioridade.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora ADVPL Pleno/Sênior
description:
Missão do cargo:

Desenvolver e sustentar funcionalidades de software, que agreguem valor ao produto, garantindo a satisfação do cliente dentro do segmento de atuação.


Temos 3 vagas em aberto. Sendo duas vaga de Desenvolvedores ADVPL Pleno e uma vaga de Desenvolvedor ADVPL Sênior.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Desenvolver soluções técnicas de média complexidade, com nível de supervisão moderado e pouco apoio, através do desenvolvimento de requisitos de softwares utilizando-se das tecnologias envolvidas no projeto;
  • Compreender a arquitetura do software e ser capaz de atuar nela através da análise de seus componentes, organização e funcionalidades;
  • Criar testes de média complexidade, sejam estes manuais ou automatizados, que cubram o comportamento desejado dos componentes técnicos desenvolvidos utilizando os requisitos e ferramentas de testes;
  • Documentar as etapas de desenvolvimento realizando o registro do desenvolvimento nas ferramentas de versionamento e documentação;
  • Orientar e trabalhar com o time de desenvolvimento para encontrar soluções de negócio, arquitetura e desenho através da comunicação e trocas de conhecimento;
  • Manter a qualidade do software verificando os processos, ferramentas e boas práticas disponíveis para o produto e tecnologia utilizados;
  • Orientar desenvolvedores de menor senioridade apoiando suas dúvidas, disseminando seu conhecimento, desenhando e arquitetando soluções ou indicando documentação de apoio;
  • Detalhar requisitos de baixa e média complexidade através do contato com clientes e áreas envolvidas no projeto/atendimento.
  • Utiliza frameworks já definidos para o desenvolvimento de soluções.



O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Lógica de Programação;
  • Banco de Dados;
  • Linguagem de programação ADVPL / TLPP
  • REST API;
  • Fundamento em testes unitários;
  • Métodos ágeis de desenvolvimento de software;
  • Regras de negócios relacionadas ao Fiscal.
  • Angular - PO UI;
  • Conhecimento em processo de negócios backoffice.
  • Superior completo ou em andamento em tecnologia e afins.

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack .Net
description:
Company Overview

SEW is the #1 Energy and Water Cloud Platform, providing cloud-based Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solutions for Digital Customer Engagement, Field Workforce Engagement, and Smart AI/Machine Learning to the Energy and Utility sector. We empower utilities to enhance customer service, optimize operational efficiency, and maximize return on investments through the SEW platform applications leveraging mobile, AI, Machine Learning, and Cloud technologies.

Searching for your dream job? At SEW, we strive to help our employees find passion and purpose. Join us in changing the way the world uses energy and water and become part of our innovative and talented team!


Position Overview

We are looking for a Mid Level Full Stack .Net Developer with good experience with C# and Angular to join our dynamic engineering team. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain robust web and mobile applications that integrate seamlessly with SEW’s platform. The ideal candidate will be passionate about building scalable and efficient software solutions and thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.


Key Responsibilities

Application Development:

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable web and mobile applications using modern frameworks and technologies.
  • Build responsive front-end interfaces that deliver exceptional user experiences.
  • Develop efficient and secure back-end services and APIs.

Analysis and Reporting:

  • Perform thorough analysis of complex data and recommend actionable strategies.
  • Develop complex database queries in SQL/TSQL and NoSQL.
  • Translate client requirements to technical architectural specifications and communicate this to delivery teams and clients.

Collaboration:

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and other developers, to define and implement solutions.
  • Participate in code reviews to ensure high-quality software development.

System Optimization:

  • Optimize application performance to ensure scalability and reliability.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve technical issues promptly.

Innovation and Best Practices:

  • Define data architecture requirements for cross-product integration within and across cloud-based platforms.
  • Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends.
  • Advocate for and implement best practices in software development, including testing, security, and CI/CD processes.
  • Write test plans and test cases to ensure application integrity is maintained.


Education and Experience Requirements

  • Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Data Engineering, or a related field.
  • Previous experience in software development and product deployment.
  • Hands-on experience with .Net Core, .Net Framework, Angular, Entity Framework, Git, Unit Tests and Pipelines.
  • Strong technical documentation skills.
  • Expertise in MySQL, Oracle, or MS SQL Server (SAP HANA is a plus).
  • Experience with cloud architecture, including AWS, Azure, and Google (SAP BTP is a plus).
  • Effectively translate data modeling and BI requirements into the design process.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent human relations and documentation skills.
  • Strong ability to interpret customer and market insights and conduct data analysis.
  • Fluent English is required; Spanish is a plus.


Why Join SEW?

  • Be part of a mission-driven organization creating impactful solutions for the energy and water sectors.
  • Collaborate with a talented and innovative team on cutting-edge projects.
  • Enjoy opportunities for professional growth and skill development.
  • Work in a culture that values diversity, creativity, and collaboration.


SEW is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Audio Transcription Specialist
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.


Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


Job Title: Audio Transcription Specialist (Language: Portuguese, Location: Portugal)


About The Role:

We are seeking detail-oriented and dedicated professionals with hands-on experience in audio transcription and quality assurance . The ideal candidate will be responsible for accurately converting audio content into written text, maintaining high standards of accuracy, consistency, and confidentiality throughout the process.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Listen carefully to audio recordings and transcribe them into clear, accurate, and grammatically correct text .
  • Identify and correct transcription errors , ensuring proper spelling, punctuation, and formatting.
  • Handle different accents, speech clarity levels, and background noises with attention to detail.
  • Tag and label transcriptions as per project guidelines.
  • Review, proofread, and edit transcripts for quality, accuracy, and completeness .
  • Follow client-specific formatting and delivery instructions.
  • Work closely with project leads and QA teams to meet daily quality and productivity targets .
  • Maintain confidentiality and data security of all content handled.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience in audio transcription or related linguistic work.
  • Excellent command of English (or other project-specific language) with strong grammar and listening skills.
  • Good typing speed and accuracy with familiarity in transcription tools or software.
  • Ability to work independently and meet tight deadlines .
  • High attention to detail and ability to follow formatting guidelines strictly.
  • Must have a reliable internet connection, functional laptop/desktop, and good-quality headphones (mandatory).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience in AI training, transcription QA, or linguistic data projects .
  • Familiarity with timestamping, labeling, or annotation tasks .
  • Experience working with global transcription platforms or large-scale linguistic projects.
  • Knowledge of speech-to-text software and audio editing tools is an added advantage.



If Interested, kindly send your resume at:

title: Advogado associado
description:
Vaga: Advogado(a) Pleno – Direito Bancário / CEF

Modalidade: Home Office

Escritório: Coelho e Gavioli – Advogados Associados

Sobre a vaga

O escritório Coelho e Gavioli – Advogados Associados está em busca de um(a) Advogado(a) Pleno com experiência em Direito Bancário , especialmente em demandas envolvendo a Caixa Econômica Federal (CEF) .

O(a) profissional atuará no contencioso cível bancário, com foco em estratégia, análise processual e condução de ações de média complexidade.

Responsabilidades

  • Gerir e conduzir processos judiciais da CEF , assegurando qualidade técnica e eficiência nos resultados;
  • Elaborar petições, relatórios e peças processuais em diferentes fases processuais;
  • Realizar análises de risco e propostas de acordo , com visão estratégica e foco em resultados;
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento e treinamentos jurídicos internos ;
  • Garantir o cumprimento de prazos e a manutenção dos padrões de qualidade do escritório.

Requisitos

  • Formação em Direito e inscrição ativa na OAB ;
  • Experiência comprovada em Direito Bancário , preferencialmente com casos envolvendo a Caixa Econômica Federal ;
  • Capacidade analítica, senso de responsabilidade e boa comunicação escrita;
  • Perfil proativo, organizado e com facilidade para trabalho remoto e em equipe.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em contencioso de massa bancário ;
  • Familiaridade com sistemas jurídicos como CPJ , PJe e plataformas de bancos públicos.

title: Agencies BD & Recruited
description:
Corporate Information

TRANSSNET Group is a joint venture company established by China's leading Internet company NetEase Group (NASDAQ: NTES) and TRANSSION Holdings Group, a global provider of smart terminal products and mobile value-added services. TRANSSNET combines NetEase’s strong technical strength and advanced Internet product operation concepts with TRANSSION’s mature channel resources and solid market foundation in Africa, becoming one of the leading Internet companies serving the most users in Africa with excellent online applications from Boomplay, the largest online music platform in Africa, to TalkTalk and SOYO, both extraordinary social apps, to mobile games.


This position will serve the social app(SOYO) business unit.


Job Requirements:

  • Fluent in English and Portuguese.
  • At least one year of experience in agency recruitment or management of a social app.
  • Excellent communication skills, able to make friends with users.
  • Sales-oriented mindset with patience.
  • Enjoy using voice social apps, familiar with various features and gameplay.
  • Reliable and loyal, with integrity and a goal-oriented approach.


Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for recruiting agencies and hosts (at least 200-300 hosts per month)
  • Assist in the translation of events and product features (English to Portuguese)

title: Content Writer
description:
Job Description:

We are seeking highly analytical and detail-oriented professionals with hands-on experience in Red Teaming, Prompt Evaluation , and AI/LLM Quality Assurance . The ideal candidate will help us rigorously test and evaluate AI-generated content to identify vulnerabilities, assess risks, and ensure compliance with safety, ethical, and quality standards.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct Red Teaming exercises to identify adversarial, harmful, or unsafe outputs from large language models (LLMs).
  • Evaluate and stress-test AI prompts across multiple domains (e.g., finance, healthcare, security) to uncover potential failure modes.
  • Develop and apply test cases to assess accuracy, bias, toxicity, hallucinations , and misuse potential in AI-generated responses.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, safety researchers, and prompt engineers to report risks and suggest mitigations.
  • Perform manual QA and content validation across model versions, ensuring factual consistency, coherence, and guideline adherence.
  • Create evaluation frameworks and scoring rubrics for prompt performance and safety compliance.
  • Document findings, edge cases, and vulnerability reports with high clarity and structure.


Requirements:

  • Proven experience in AI red teaming , LLM safety testing, or adversarial prompt design.
  • Familiarity with prompt engineering , NLP tasks, and ethical considerations in generative AI.
  • Strong background in Quality Assurance , content review, or test case development for AI/ML systems.
  • Understanding of LLM behaviors, failure modes, and model evaluation metrics.
  • Excellent critical thinking, pattern recognition, and analytical writing skills.
  • Ability to work independently, follow detailed evaluation protocols, and meet tight deadlines.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior work with teams like OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, or other LLM safety initiatives.
  • Experience in risk assessment, red team security testing, or AI policy & governance.

Background in linguistics, psychology, or computational ethics is a plus.


Next Steps

To proceed further in the evaluation process, you will need to complete two assessments:

  • Assessment Test
  • Evaluates your linguistic and analytical skills
  • Link:



  • Versant English Proficiency Test
  • Focuses on assessing your spoken and written English proficiency
  • A C1 or C2 level is required to qualify


Once both assessments are successfully completed, you will be eligible for onboarding.

  • Language test


Action Required: XConnect Registration

You will also receive an invitation to our internal job platform, XConnect . Please take a few minutes to register and complete your profile. All project onboarding, communication, and documentation are managed through this platform.


If interested, kindly share your resume at:

title: Capital Agents
description:
We’re Expanding Our Global Capital Agent Network – Join Magnum Equities as an Independent Capital Agent


Remote | Global | Commission-Based | #PrivateEquity #CapitalRaising #InvestmentOpportunities #CapitalAgent #Agent #Broker #InvestmentBanker #PrivateMarkets #VentureCapital #Entrepreneurship


Are you a capital introducer, private banker, independent dealmaker, ultra-networker, or connected investment professional looking to monetize your network?


Magnum is seeking experienced Capital Agents to join our global sourcing network. These independent agents will facilitate capital to Magnum Equities and earn 2% commission on successfully funded partnership capital placements, from fiat currency to crypto currency.


Capital Agent – Independent Investment Sourcing Partner


Location: Global | Remote

Full | Part-time or Side gig with your current job


Industry: You can be of any industry sector background, early/mid/or late in your career, having a capital network of partnership investment prospects that desire high ROI via profit share in Magnum’s global real estate and business equities assets growth forward, and large-scale social impact.


Commission: 2% of Capital Raised


About Magnum Equities


Magnum is foremost a mass capital investment partnership platform, capital raise platform for SME's, and mass social impact/empowerment powerhouse. Magnum's main pillars: Real Estate Assets Partners | Tech/Business Equity Partners | Precious Metals | Sukuk (Marabaha) enabling Shariah compliant capital placement investment from micro to macro capital partners, via “Magnum Equities Partnership Tokenization". Enabling globally democratized - low barrier to entry (min 50 Euros/token) - investment, empowering individuals to large institutional capital placement participation in Magnum’s global portfolio rather than being limited to only a specific single asset, optimizing short/medium/long term (3-5yrs), ROI (3X/5X/10X/100X/2500X+), and abatement of any singular asset downside. Magnum also empowers Capital Agents with lucrative revenue streams for their facilitated capital. These can be individuals, SF/MF Private offices, fund managers, capital management firms, institutional etc. Fiat currency, & crypto currency investment enabled.


Our global investors are significantly advantaged leveraging their purchase of Magnum’s RWA tokens as profit share rights in Magnum's aggregate global performance forward. Micro to Macro partnerships via fractional partnership profit share tokenization on blockchain via our RWA/PropTech blockchain/fintech partner portal.


Magnum’s innovative fractional partnership structure provides flexibility to vest capital across GCC/MENA/North America Strategic Growth region assets without requiring local RWA tokenization adoption. Magnum enables periodic ROI distributions based on portfolio-wide performance metrics via smart contracts.


Magnum’s cutting edge RWA tokenized profit share partnership model maintains investors’ blockchain-enabled transparency.


Magnum provides its profit share partners/investors with what entities such as Berkshire Hathaway have provided capital investors, except much more opportunity, scope, innovation integration, social impact, & mass low barrier of entry to participate - individually to institutionally.

With Magnum, whether your vested fractional profit share tokens are aligned with our entire Real Estate focused portfolio, or as accredited investor choosing from our globally located Cross-industry sector companies seeking to raise capital, or both, you’re not stuck with just one asset, gated entry points, or vague returns. It’s about real productive assets you can see, touch, and feel, as well as large-scale pan-global business equity positions. Partners get fractional profit share access to a massive diverse portfolio, smart contract-driven payouts, and a model built for transparency and real growth.


Magnum is foremost a global partnership investment platform that lets you own fractional profit share rights in real-world assets (Large Scale Real Estate and Cross-Industry Business Equity)—tokenized for transparency, diversification, and ease of access. Think of it as owning a piece of a global portfolio, without needing millions to get started. Magnum is also engineered to be a democratizing, equal opportunity, income/earnings empowerment platform for often displaced masses of global micro investors to institutional, that want to be associated with a mass legacy-driven, cutting edge investment and social impact platform that empowers and restores micro-investor hope, dignity, respect, income equality, standard of living, growth, and vision within an investment climate that has historically displaced the masses. Magnum levels the playing field, ensuring equal opportunity and low barrier to entry. Is it a global movement? We think so.


Who does Magnum serve


Our model supports everyone—from Micro partners/investors (global individuals) to UHNW, Single/Multi-Family Offices, Institutional – Pension | Insurance | SWF | Investment Authorities | Endowments | Foundation/Charitable | PE Funds | VC | Hedge | Real Estate | Infrastructure Funds etc. while empowering all our capital agents.


Role Overview


As a Capital Agent, you will:


  • Introduce and complete partner funding qualified capital partners/investors to the Magnum platform
  • Facilitate warm introductions and/or participate in closing efforts
  • Earn 2% on capital you raise – Simple!
  • Operate independently and flexibly, without exclusive commitment


What We Offer


  • Attractive transparent commission model - Unique Agent link to use | Earnings wallet
  • Leverage Magnum’s professionally curated pitch decks, site resources etc
  • Flexible, remote-first role – ideal for global professionals
  • Dedicated support: Capital partner relationship team and due diligence assistance
  • No licensing required (you are not soliciting or selling securities directly), only introductions to partnership
  • Global flexibility: Operate remotely, with no territory or geographic limits


Who This Is For


  • Individuals, capital introducers, private bankers, fund managers, capital firms, representative/legal firms, brokers, salespeople, investment professionals, endowments, charitable orgs with access to capital and capital networks
  • Individuals with relationships across single/multifamily offices, UHNWIs, boutique funds, or estate channels
  • Professionals looking to monetize their network without the burden of licensing or fund management


*Charitable organizations can utilize their Capital Agent role to drive mass charitable, and social impact for their various current and future programs.


This mass individual empowerment and expansive social impact integration is a purposeful and very important component to us at Magnum, in keeping with our 125yr tradition, where democratized opportunity for all, at every socio-economic level, every geo-location in developed and under-developed nations, can raise the ‘economic base of the societal pyramid’ in every region. Where capitalism can co-exist without displacement, with equality, dignity, respect, levelling the contentious playing field between the “have’s and the have not’s”.


Commission Example (2% on capital intake from each partner capital placement with Magnum)


Raise 1,000 EU  Earn 20 EU- Micro partners/investors (global individuals)


Raise $100,000 EU  Earn 2,000 EU – Individuals | HNW | Small fund portfolios


Raise 5M EU  Earn 100,000 EU – UHNW | Single/Multi-Family Offices | Fund portfolios


Raise 10M EU  Earn 200,000 EU - UHNW | Single/Multi-Family Offices | Fund portfolios | Institutional – Pension | Insurance | SWF | Investment Authorities | Foundations/Charitable | Philanthropic Capital | PE Funds | VC | Hedge | Real Estate | Endowments | Infrastructure Funds etc.


Raise 100M EU  Earn 2,000,000 EU - Multi-Family Offices | Fund portfolios | Institutional – Pension | Insurance | SWF | Investment Authorities | Foundations/Charitable | Philanthropic Capital | PE Funds | VC | Hedge | Real Estate | Endowments | Infrastructure Funds etc.


Raise 1 Bill EU  Earn 20,000,000 EU - Institutional – Pension | Insurance | SWF | Investment Authorities | Foundations/Charitable | Philanthropic Capital | PE Funds | VC | Hedge | Real Estate | Endowments | Infrastructure Funds | Gov’t Treasury | IMF | World Banks etc.


Raise 10 Bill EU  Earn 200,000,000 EU - Institutional – Pension | Insurance | SWF | Foundations/Charitable | Philanthropic Capital | PE Funds | VC | Hedge | Real Estate | Endowments | Infrastructure Funds | Gov’t Treasury | IMF | World Banks etc.


Easy Next Step


Interested in joining the Magnum Equities Capital agent network?


Register as Capital Agent directly on Magnum's website:


Important Notes & Disclaimers


  • Magnum Equities does not require Capital Agents to hold securities licenses, as you are not directly soliciting or selling investment products. Only presenting partnership opportunity.

  • All final post-placement due diligence, AML etc are handled internally by Magnum management.
  • This is a commission-only independent agent role. It is not an offer of employment, partnership, or representation, and no exclusivity or guarantees of earnings are provided.
  • Magnum Equities reserves the right to approve or reject capital partners at its sole discretion based on internal compliance protocols.

Think of it as owning a piece of a global portfolio, without needing millions to get started. Magnum is also engineered to be a democratizing, equal opportunity, income/earnings empowerment platform for often displaced masses of global micro investors to institutional, that want to be associated with a mass legacy-driven, cutting edge investment and social impact platform that empowers and restores micro-investor hope, dignity, respect, income equality, standard of living, growth, and vision within an investment climate that has historically displaced the masses. Magnum levels the playing field, ensuring equal opportunity and low barrier to entry. Is it a global movement? We think so.


Who does Magnum serve


Our model supports everyone—from Micro partners/investors (global individuals) to UHNW, Single/Multi-Family Offices, Institutional – Pension | Insurance | SWF | Investment Authorities | Endowments | Foundation/Charitable | PE Funds | VC | Hedge | Real Estate | Infrastructure Funds etc. while empowering all our capital agents.


Role Overview


As a Capital Agent, you will:


  • Introduce and complete partner funding qualified capital partners/investors to the Magnum platform
  • Facilitate warm introductions and/or participate in closing efforts
  • Earn 2% on capital you raise – Simple!
  • Operate independently and flexibly, without exclusive commitment


What We Offer


  • Attractive transparent commission model - Unique Agent link to use | Earnings wallet
  • Leverage Magnum’s professionally curated pitch decks, site resources etc
  • Flexible, remote-first role – ideal for global professionals
  • Dedicated support: Capital partner relationship team and due diligence assistance
  • No licensing required (you are not soliciting or selling securities directly), only introductions to partnership
  • Global flexibility: Operate remotely, with no territory or geographic limits


Who This Is For


  • Individuals, capital introducers, private bankers, fund managers, capital firms, representative/legal firms, brokers, salespeople, investment professionals, endowments, charitable orgs with access to capital and capital networks
  • Individuals with relationships across single/multifamily offices, UHNWIs, boutique funds, or estate channels
  • Professionals looking to monetize their network without the burden of licensing or fund management


*Charitable organizations can utilize their Capital Agent role to drive mass charitable, and social impact for their various current and future programs.


This mass individual empowerment and expansive social impact integration is a purposeful and very important component to us at Magnum, in keeping with our 125yr tradition, where democratized opportunity for all, at every socio-economic level, every geo-location in developed and under-developed nations, can raise the ‘economic base of the societal pyramid’ in every region. Where capitalism can co-exist without displacement, with equality, dignity, respect, levelling the contentious playing field between the “have’s and the have not’s”.

title: KYC Analyst（remote）
description:
Responsibilities:


Conduct international verification case reviews, including individual and corporate verifications.

Review and confirm the results of Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and economic sanctions blacklist screenings.

Coordinate with other departments on KYC/CDD-related workflows and process daily applications.

Assist in optimizing the global customer KYC/CDD process.

Analyze KYC vendor review situations and seek better solutions.

Assist in monitoring the daily status of KYC/CDD and check the system's operation.

Conduct research on the KYC/CDD regulatory requirements and documentation for different countries and complete the research report.

Assist in the implementation of AML policies and other policies involving KYC/CDD.

Responsible for dealing with difficult KYC problems related to Portuguese, Spanish if applicable.

Support the Team Leader in completing other related tasks.


Position Requirements:


A bachelor's degree or higher in finance, law, economics, auditing, languages or related fields from a full-time university program (preference for graduates from internationally renowned universities). Proficiency in Mandarin is preferred.

At least two years of experience in KYC/CDD or other compliance-related roles within banks, securities, or other financial institutions is preferred.

Proficiency in English, with the ability to use English as a working language.

Portuguese or Spanish is the native language.

Familiarity with Anti-Money Laundering and international economic sanctions theories; CAMS certification is a plus.

A stable personality with a strong sense of compliance and responsibility, strong learning and stress tolerance abilities, good communication skills, meticulous work, high enthusiasm, and a sense of responsibility.

Basic data analysis skills and proficiency in using office software such as Excel, Word, PPT.

title: Desenvolvedor Pleno (GIS)

Analisar, planejar e executar desenvolvimento e/ou manutenção de soluções de GIS/TI nas fases de Design, Construção, Tecnologia, Requisitos, Teste, Infraestrutura, Configuração e Qualidade.


Formação:

  • Graduado.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de software;
  • Experiência trabalhando com serviços restfull e microserviços;
  • Conhecimentos em html5, CSS3, node.js, angular, vue e react;
  • Conhecimentos em Python;
  • Conhecimentos em SQL e Análise de Dados;
  • Experiência em levantar e documentar requisitos juntos aos usuários;
  • Capacidade de realizar testes unitários e de integração;
  • Capacidade de desenvolvimento de soluções utilizando todas as linguagens suportadas na plataforma ArcGIS.


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Certificações;
  • Especializações/Mestrado;
  • Inglês Avançado;
  • Vivência em metodologias ágeis;
  • Conhecimentos na plataforma ArcGIS;
  • Capacidade de análise crítica de especificações de sistemas e negócios.


Responsabilidades:

  • Escrever códigos de desenvolvimento dos sistemas seguindo padrões de nomenclatura e práticas da empresa;
  • Detalhar projetos, determinando suas interfaces, limites de automação e plataforma tecnológica;
  • Construir modelos funcionais e de dados de sistemas, aplicando boas práticas que garantam visão estruturada, qualidade, reutilização, facilidade de manutenção de códigos;
  • Identificar, avaliar e definir frameworks, componentes e softwares para desenvolvimento, através da conceituação, documentação e experimentação, buscando aprimorar as soluções desenvolvidas;
  • Realizar avaliações de segurança e performance de soluções;
  • Aplicar e avaliar testes funcionais e não funcionais, seguindo o plano de testes estabelecido, junto ao cliente visando a entrega da solução e satisfação do cliente;
  • Escrever o plano de testes funcionais e não funcionais visando a entrega da solução e satisfação do cliente;
  • Avaliar e elaborar a documentação de usuário e administração de sistemas desenvolvidos e os repositórios de informação dos projetos;
  • Assegurar as interfaces de integração com outras plataformas/soluções.

title: Senior Devops Engineer
description:
About the job


At Avenue Code, we are passionate about transforming businesses through technology. We are a leading end-to-end development consultancy for digital transformation across various markets, growing sustainably since day one. We believe that great results are born from strong relationships. Our team combines technical expertise, collaboration, and a welcoming approach to work that makes all the difference.



About the Opportunity


We are seeking a Engineer to join our high-performing engineering team, focused on building highly available, large-scale, and low-latency data platforms . This role is ideal for a hands-on, experienced engineer who can immediately contribute to solving complex challenges, driving technical excellence, and enhancing our DevOps and backend infrastructure.

You’ll join a collaborative, empowered, and agile team responsible for enterprise data distribution applications and backend APIs that serve external customers worldwide, including international markets such as Canada and Japan . This position offers the opportunity to take ownership of critical DevOps operations, design scalable solutions, and continuously evolve our platform’s reliability, performance, and security.


Responsibilities


  • Design, build, and maintain highly available and scalable backend systems and APIs.
  • Lead and own DevOps initiatives , including CI/CD pipeline management, cloud infrastructure, and container orchestration.
  • Implement and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform , ensuring secure, reproducible, and automated deployments.
  • Work closely with stakeholders, product owners, and cross-functional teams to deliver new features and improve existing systems .
  • Ensure disaster recovery readiness and compliance with security best practices .
  • Manage and optimize AWS services (S3, RDS, EventBridge, SQS, IAM, VPC, ECR, etc.).
  • Deploy and manage Kubernetes (EKS) clusters and Docker images in production environments.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across distributed systems and drive root cause analysis.
  • Maintain high standards of code quality, testing, and documentation .
  • Collaborate across engineering teams (Platform, Security, UX) to ensure seamless integration and delivery.


Required Qualifications


  • 8+ years of professional experience in functional programming , with Node.js / JavaScript (not TypeScript).
  • Proven experience with DevOps practices and cloud-native environments .
  • Deep hands-on experience with Kubernetes (EKS) and Docker .
  • Expertise with AWS (S3, RDS, EventBridge, SQS, DMS, Security Groups, IAM, VPCs, ECR).
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with relational databases (MSSQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Aurora, RDS).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows.
  • Familiarity with Terraform (infrastructure as code).
  • Solid understanding of application security and use of security tools (e.g., Wiz, Snyk ).
  • Strong debugging, issue resolution, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in an agile environment.
  • Pragmatic mindset with a strong sense of ownership and craftsmanship .


Nice to Have Skills


  • Experience with automated database migrations and versioning.
  • Background in API integration and distribution systems .
  • Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana).
  • Exposure to multi-region cloud deployments .
  • Previous experience supporting regulated industries or compliance-driven environments.
  • Passion for mentoring team members and driving engineering best practices.



Avenue Code ensures the privacy of all candidates in compliance with regulations such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA, and CPRA. The data will be used solely for recruitment processes and may be shared, in a limited manner, with clients and CompassUOL Group companies when necessary to provide services.

title: Supervisor de Lazer
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Supervisionar, treinar e motivar os agentes de viagens;
  • Acompanhar o desempenho individual e coletivo da equipe;
  • Promover um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e orientado para resultados.
  • Garantir um atendimento de excelência aos clientes, presencialmente, por telefone ou online;
  • Resolver conflitos, reclamações e situações complexas de atendimento;
  • Manter um padrão de qualidade nos serviços prestados pela equipe.
  • Supervisionar a montagem de pacotes turísticos, nacionais e internacionais;
  • Apoiar na negociação com fornecedores (companhias aéreas, hotéis, operadoras, etc.);
  • Garantir que as ofertas estejam atualizadas, competitivas e dentro das políticas da empresa.
  • Acompanhar reservas, emissões, alterações e cancelamentos de serviços;
  • Monitorar prazos, documentos e pagamentos junto aos fornecedores;
  • Garantir que todos os processos estejam em conformidade com as normas legais e políticas internas.
  • Colaborar com o setor comercial para alcançar metas de vendas;
  • Sugerir campanhas, promoções e ações para captação e fidelização de clientes;
  • Analisar relatórios de desempenho e propor melhorias.
  • Monitorar metas, produtividade e qualidade do atendimento;
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e apresentar resultados à direção.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre destinos, tendências do mercado e novidades do setor;
  • Incentivar a equipe a participar de treinamentos, workshops e famtours.
  • Mais as atribuições de vendas, pois o supervisor também vende


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Conhecimento dos destinos de viagem, geografia.
  • Conhecimento em informática.
  • Ensino médio completo, desejável ensino superior em turismo.
  • Experiência em agência de viagens multimarcas.

title: Senior Microsoft Teams Specialist
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Senior Microsoft Teams Specialist who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will:


Administer and optimize Microsoft Teams, including channels, policies, integrations, and APIs.

Automate processes and recommend engineering improvements.

Monitor alerts, analyze root causes, and implement solutions.

Work with PowerShell, MS Graph, and application management in Teams.

Test new features and implement changes securely.

What we're looking for:

Strong experience with Microsoft Teams, M365, and integrations.

Proficiency in PowerShell/MS Graph.

Experience managing applications, APIs, and automation.

Knowledge of RCA (Root Cause Analysis) and service improvement.

Fluent in English


What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

  • TCS Benefits – Brazil:
  • Health insurance
  • Dental Plan
  • Life insurance
  • Transportation vouchers
  • Meal/Food Voucher
  • Childcare assistance
  • Gympass
  • TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates
  • Partnership with SESC
  • Reimbursement of Certifications
  • Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training
  • International experience opportunity
  • Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools
  • Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire
  • TCS Gems – Recognition for performance
  • Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Auxiliar Técnico em Eletrica Automotiva
description:
Sobre a Empresa


O sucesso da Flash Engenharia é consequência do compromisso com um trabalho sério e de longo prazo, assumido pelos jovens engenheiros que hoje atuam na gestão colaborativa da empresa. Nossa maior característica, além da excelência em tecnologia embarcada, é o comprometimento com nossos clientes tanto no cumprimento de prazos, como também no oferecimento de alta qualidade e transparência!


Responsabilidades


  • Auxiliar em análises técnicas através de scanner automotivo, gestão de cargas de bateria dos veículos, conforme procedimentos internos;
  • Elaboração de relatórios e indicadores;
  • Suporte técnicos aos demais departamentos.


Habilidades Necessárias:

title: Senior Business Analyst - 100% Home office - Inglês e Espanhol avançados
description:
Título do cargo: Desenvolvedor Backend Sênior em Sistemas de Pagamento


Localização: Brasil - 100% home office

Horário: De segunda-feira a sexta-feira das 09h00 às 18h00.



Sobre a Motivus


Na Motivus, acreditamos em liberar o potencial humano por meio de soluções inovadoras e de ponta. Com mais de 1.600 colaboradores em 5 países, oferecemos um amplo espectro de serviços de software e soluções digitais. Nossas equipes são dedicadas a impulsionar a sustentabilidade, expandir os limites da tecnologia e construir a próxima geração de soluções digitais de classe mundial que capacitam nossos clientes e geram impacto duradouro. Ao se juntar à nossa equipe, você trabalhará com profissionais visionários comprometidos em criar soluções inovadoras que moldam o futuro da indústria.


Foco:

Levantamento de requisitos e análise funcional para sistemas de pagamento.


Responsabilidades:

  • Coletar e documentar requisitos com clientes (bancos, adquirentes, etc.).
  • Fazer análise de gap entre os requisitos do cliente e as soluções FIS.
  • Elaborar documentação funcional e regras de negócio .
  • Trabalhar junto com os desenvolvedores para garantir entregas adequadas.
  • Comunicar-se diretamente com o cliente final (em espanhol).


Requisitos técnicos

  • Domínio em ISO 8583 e conceitos de redes de pagamento (Visa, Mastercard, etc.) .
  • Experiência em processos de certificação de redes e regras de negócio de pagamentos .
  • Habilidade para escrever requisitos funcionais detalhados .
  • Espanhol fluente e inglês avançado.
  • Desejável conhecimento funcional de produtos FIS (IST Switch, Clearing, CBK, etc.).


Perfil ideal

Um analista com forte base funcional em sistemas de pagamento , excelente comunicação com clientes e capacidade analítica para traduzir processos de negócio em especificações técnicas.


Por Que Se Juntar a Nós?


  • Desenvolva sua Carreira: Na Motivus, você terá a oportunidade de expandir suas habilidades e assumir cargos de liderança em projetos diversificados.
  • Trabalhe com Tecnologias Emergentes: Esteja na vanguarda da inovação, trabalhando com tecnologias e metodologias de ponta.
  • Ambiente Colaborativo: Trabalhe com equipes talentosas que valorizam suas ideias e contribuições.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento: Oferecemos uma variedade de programas de L&D para ajudá-lo a progredir em sua carreira.
  • Abordagem Centrada no Cliente: Contribua para soluções que criam valor duradouro para clientes globais da Fortune 500.


Nossos Valores


  • Cultura de Inovação: Buscamos incessantemente a inovação, incentivando nossas equipes a explorar novas ideias e tecnologias.
  • Responsabilidade: Devolvemos às comunidades que nos apoiam e aos nossos clientes.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento: Nossos colaboradores lideram, aprendem e crescem, apoiando a si mesmos e a nossos clientes.

title: Desenvolvedor .NET Sr
description:
Estamos buscando um talento para a posição de DESENVOLVEDOR .NET SENIOR


A G4F é uma empresa com uma trajetória sólida de 15 anos, dedicada a conectar pessoas, ideias e tecnologia para oferecer soluções inovadoras. Somos mais de 8.000 #greaters atuando em todo o Brasil.


Requisitos:

Graduação em curso de nível superior na área de TI;

Experiência com codificação de aplicações C#.NET, ASP.NET;

• MCSA: Microsoft Certified Solutions Associate: Web Applications;

• MCSD: Microsoft Certified Solutions Developer: App Builder;

• Microsoft Certified Azure Developer Associate.

Experiência no desenvolvimento de projetos baseados em Metodologia Ágil, adotando requisitos ágeis e histórias do usuário.

Experiência na técnica Acceptance Test Driven Development (ATDD) usando Cucumber ou equivalente.

Experiência na área de Sistema Operacional Windows Server:

• configuração do Internet Information Server;

• configuração, instalação e publicação de aplicações e assemblies .NET;

• conceitos de versionamento de assemblies e binding policies em WCF (Windows Communication Foundation);

• conhecimentos de COM e COM+;

• conhecimentos de MTS;

• conceitos de Windows Internals;

• conceitos de Active Directory;

• conceitos de Windows API

Experiência na área de Desenvolvimento Linguagem C# .Net:

• conceitos de interoperabilidade entre plataforma .NET (código gerenciado / managed) e COM+ (código não gerenciado / unmanaged);

• conceitos e técnicas de segurança em .NET (Autenticação, autorização e comunicação segura);

• criação de WebServices em WCF para IIS/WAS;
